title: CORE-7142 · SITEWIDE: missing theme-color meta — mobile browser chrome not branded
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7142](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7142)

## Verified 2026-08-24 — reproduces

Live sets `<meta name="theme-color" content="#00b1e3">`; the clone emits none, so mobile
browser chrome renders unbranded.

| | theme-color |
|---|---|
| Live `rapidformations.co.uk` | `#00b1e3` |
| Clone (prod) | **none** — 0 occurrences in the served HTML |

## Must be brand-scoped, not global

This repo serves three brands (`src/lib/brand.ts`: 1st Formations, Quality Company
Formations, Rapid Formations) off one codebase, and a hardcoded value would leak across
all of them. Checked each brand's live site before choosing:

| Brand | Live theme-color | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Rapid Formations | `#00b1e3` | fetched, present |
| Quality Company Formations | **none** | fetched HTTP 200, 405KB, 0 occurrences — genuinely absent |
| 1st Formations | unknown | HTTP 403, Cloudflare-blocked |

So `themeColor` is an OPTIONAL field on `DomainConfig`, set only for Rapid Formations.
QCF correctly inherits nothing (matching its live site) and 1F stays absent rather than
guessing a value.

`#00b1e3` is the brand cyan already in the theme (`--surface-brand-cyan: rgb(0 177 227)`).
acceptanceCriteria: The clone emits `<meta name="theme-color" content="#00b1e3">` on every page when the brand is Rapid Formations, matching live.
The value is brand-scoped — QCF and 1st Formations do NOT inherit it, since QCF's live site sets no theme-color.
No other head metadata changes (openGraph, twitter, metadataBase untouched).
Typecheck and production build both pass.
